SELECT u.id AS id, u.login_name AS loginName, u.display_name AS displayName, u.password_hash AS passwordHash, un.unit_name AS unitName, un.status AS unitStatus, u.status AS accountStatus, u.authorization_version AS authorizationVersion,
(SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(r.role_code ORDER BY r.role_code SEPARATOR ',') FROM sys_user_role ur JOIN sys_role r ON r.id = ur.role_id WHERE ur.user_id = u.id AND r.status = 'ENABLED') AS aggregatedRoleCodes, (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(r.role_name ORDER BY r.role_code SEPARATOR ',') FROM sys_user_role ur JOIN sys_role r ON r.id = ur.role_id WHERE ur.user_id = u.id AND r.status = 'ENABLED') AS aggregatedRoleNames,
(SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT p.permission_code ORDER BY p.permission_code SEPARATOR ',') FROM sys_user_role ur JOIN sys_role r ON r.id = ur.role_id JOIN sys_role_permission rp ON rp.role_id = r.id JOIN sys_permission p ON p.id = rp.permission_id WHERE ur.user_id = u.id AND r.status = 'ENABLED') AS aggregatedPermissionCodes FROM sys_user u JOIN sys_unit un ON un.id = u.unit_id WHERE u.login_name = CONVERT(#{loginName} USING ascii) COLLATE ascii_bin

SELECT u.login_name AS loginName, u.display_name AS displayName, un.unit_name AS unitName, un.unit_level AS unitLevel, parent.unit_name AS parentUnitName FROM sys_user u JOIN sys_unit un ON un.id = u.unit_id LEFT JOIN sys_unit parent ON parent.id = un.parent_id WHERE u.status = 'ENABLED' AND un.status = 'ENABLED' ORDER BY un.unit_level, un.unit_code, CASE WHEN u.login_name = 'demo.hq.admin' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, u.login_name
SELECT u.status AS accountStatus, un.status AS unitStatus, u.authorization_version AS authorizationVersion FROM sys_user u JOIN sys_unit un ON un.id = u.unit_id WHERE u.id = #{userId}
